test_cases.name: from_url
test_cases.input: Create Pinterest pins from this blog post: https://example.com/best-remote-work-tips
assertions: Generates 3 or more portrait images using render_generated_image
Provides Pinterest titles, descriptions, and hashtags for each image

test_cases.name: from_pasted_text
test_cases.input: Generate Pinterest images for this article about meal prep for beginners: [pasted 800-word post]
assertions: Extracts key tips and hooks from the text
Creates varied image concepts (cover, tip list, lifestyle)

test_cases.name: quote_and_tips_focus
test_cases.input: Make Pinterest pins from this productivity blog post. Focus on the main tips and any good quotes.
assertions: Includes at least one quote-style pin if quotes exist
All images use portrait orientation suitable for Pinterest
